summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the physical dimensions and directional characteristics of various antennas, specifically for routers. A key point addressed was the definition of 'Omni-Directional' signal coverage; it was clarified that this term generally refers to a 2D plane rather than a full sphere (3D space). The conversation also touched upon proper mounting orientation (horizontal vs. vertical) and comparing antenna types from different manufacturers (Ruckus vs. Teltonika).
decisions: The general definition of 'Omni-Directional' coverage was established as 2D plane distribution.
